name: Gobustan Rock Art Cultural Landscape
description: Gobustan is a plateau of boulders rising from the semi-desert about 70 km southwest of Baku, Azerbaijan. Its rocks carry more than 6,000 engravings of hunters, animals, dancers, reed boats with oarsmen and camel caravans. Prehistoric people also sheltered in the caves here, so you can see where they lived as well as what they carved.
